Aarav Mishra | aarav.mishra892@example.com | +91 9541990513
Bengaluru. Notice period: 90 days.

Senior Data Engineer, Orbit Health — Jun 2016 - Present
Led design and production deployment of patient-data pipelines that aggregate and normalize incoming EHR, claims, and sensor feeds into Snowflake; implemented partitioned tables and micro-batch ingestion reducing ETL lag from 6 hours to under 30 minutes using Apache Airflow and Spark. Built Python-based data validation and anomaly detection routines that prevented bad records reaching analytics datasets; automated alerting and retries in Airflow DAGs. Collaborated with analytics and ML teams to deliver feature store extracts in Snowflake, improving model training turnaround by 40%. Managed Git-based CI for dbt models and orchestrated releases with documented runbooks in Confluence. Tuned Spark jobs on EMR and optimized Snowflake warehouse sizing to cut cloud costs by ~25%.

Big Data Engineer, Zoho — Mar 2012 - May 2016
Developed ETL pipelines to consolidate multi-product event streams into central Snowflake schemas; implemented Airflow DAGs for orchestration and scheduling of daily and hourly loads. Wrote complex SQL for data quality checks and ad-hoc analytics, reducing time-to-insight for product metrics teams. Created reusable Python extraction utilities and Spark transformations to handle high-throughput event processing, enabling a reliable feed used by reporting and experimentation platforms. Documented standards and pipeline designs in Confluence and maintained versioned artifacts in Git.

Skills: Python3, SQL, Spark, Apache Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, Git, Linux, Confluence

Education: B.Tech, Electronics, NIT Trichy
